message: fix(environment): keep village furniture and training ground clear of the river
purpose: Repair the actual furnishing catalog failure. Move the anvil onto its smithy forecourt and the practice ring onto dry ground. Strengthen underlying-terrain validation for non-solid ground art instead of bypassing collision checks.

replacements.old: if (!occupied.Add((x, y))) errors.Add("Overlapping solid furnishings " + zone.Id);
replacements.new: if (item.Solid && !occupied.Add((x, y))) errors.Add("Overlapping solid furnishings " + zone.Id);

replacements.old: // Never conceal water, lava, or an existing wall under a furniture sprite.
replacements.new: // Ground art also must not make water or masonry look traversable.

if (mode == "ground") f.Ground = true;
                if (mode == "concealed-wall") { f.Solid = false; f.Ground = true; f.X = 1; f.Y = 1; }
